# Windows system MP3 gapless fixtures

Project-owned deterministic synthetic PCM encoded by Windows Media Foundation,
then wrapped by remdia's independent Xing/LAME-compatible gapless mux. No LAME
encoder was used. Generated by SDK revision 14878e5, Windows-2025 CI run
https://github.com/L-Chris/remdia/actions/runs/40787374671 .

All files are 16-kHz mono. The filename gives the exact valid PCM sample count.
Input is the xorshift/low-pass signal defined in
`windows_gapless_mp3_preserves_count_and_signal_alignment_without_lame`.
Fixtures and their generation/test code are MIT licensed.

`windows_export_gapless_tags_interoperate_with_system_and_compat_demux` reads
them through both the installed system demux and independent Symphonia reader,
using only the system audio decoder, checking count and zero-offset correlation.
